scenario_description:
Objective: Add optional remote propane-gauge visibility during tomorrow's routine top-off without changing ordinary fuel service.
Emerging Need: A trial accessory is only a vague possibility until compatible stock, safe tank condition, and the route-desk process line up.
Decision Context: Stored propane notes identify the cabin's tank dial and limit participation to a reversible no-cost clip-on trial; live updates establish the scheduled stop, cap condition, contact path, and manifest deadline.
Consequence: Ignoring the chance leaves normal manual gauge checks unchanged, while after manifest lock the convenience add-on cannot ride with this delivery.

parameter.title: Propane autumn top-off
parameter.description: Blue Ledge Propane scheduled routine fill for the cabin tank during the Friday rural route.

parameter.subject: Small remote-gauge trial may be on tomorrow's East Hill truck
parameter.body: Blue Ledge is testing a few no-cost clip-on remote propane-gauge readers on selected East Hill top-off stops this week. The trial does not change fills or manual gauge checks. Compatibility and request instructions will be sent once the truck inventory is confirmed.

parameter.content: Dropped the mail bin on your porch. I passed the propane tank on the way out: the plastic gauge cap is still clipped on and clear, and the dial face isn't fogged. I'm heading back to town now, so that's the only tank look I can give today.

parameter.name: Blue Ledge Propane Route Desk
parameter.notes: Handles routine route add-ons and trial-device requests for Montpelier rural deliveries; email is preferred while the daily manifest is open.

parameter.subject: East Hill truck has three clip-on gauge readers; manifest closes 1:30
parameter.body: Today's inventory check found three no-cost telemetry clips for tomorrow's East Hill propane route. They fit 500-gallon tanks with Morrison-ready dial faces when the clear cap is intact. If a customer wants one clipped on during an already scheduled fill, email this desk before 1:30 PM with the account name, tank size, and confirmation that the gauge cap is clear and intact. The trial is removable at the next fill and does not require wiring, excavation, or a service contract.

parameter.subject: East Hill trial-reader list is now locked
parameter.body: The East Hill truck manifest is locked for tomorrow, including the three remote-gauge trial readers. Additional clip-on requests will wait for a later route if the pilot continues.
